Rules</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="830" x="485" y="-2020" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bQDZUSMfQnqRrY3KcDnO-320" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;fontSize=23;" value="<div align="left"><div><div align="left"><font>Business Relationship Rules:&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></div><div align="left"><font><br></font></div><div align="left"><font>&nbsp; * A <b>user</b> may create many <b>title</b>s. A <b>title</b> is created by exactly one <b>user</b>.&nbsp;<br>&nbsp; * A <b>user</b> may create many <b>review</b>s. A <b>review</b> is written by exactly one <b>user</b>.<br>&nbsp; * A <b>user</b> must have one or many <b>permission</b>s. A <b>permission</b> is granted to one or more <b>user</b>s (associative relation).<br>&nbsp; * A <b>user</b> must be part of one or many <b>group</b>s. A <b>group</b> must contain one or many <b>user</b>s (associative relation).<br>&nbsp; * A <b>user</b> may add many <b>title</b>s to their <b>user_title_watchlist</b>. A <b>title</b> may appear on many <b>user_title_watchlist</b>s (associative relation).<br>&nbsp; * A <b>user</b> may report many <b>title</b>s via <b>title_report</b>. A <b>title</b> may be reported by many <b>user</b>s (associative relation).<br><br>&nbsp; * A <b>title</b> must have one or many <b>author</b>s. An <b>author</b> must be associated with one or many <b>title</b>s (associative relation).<br>&nbsp; * A <b>title</b> must be part of one or many <b>genre</b>s. A <b>genre</b> must be associated with one or many <b>title</b>s (associative relation).<br>&nbsp; * A <b>title</b>&nbsp;may have many `review`s. A <b>review</b> is part of exactly one <b>title</b>.&nbsp;</font></div><div align="left"><div><font><br></font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font>Database Normalization:&nbsp;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font>&nbsp; This is in first normal form (1NF) because:</font></div><div><font>&nbsp; &nbsp; * Each entity has a unique identifier, thus all rows for each entity is unique.</font></div><div><font>&nbsp; &nbsp; * Each cell in each row within each entity only holds a singe value.&nbsp;</font></div><div><font>&nbsp; &nbsp; * Each cell in each row within each entity has a value that cannot be decomposed further.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font>&nbsp; This relation is also in second normal form (2NF) because:</font></div><div><font>&nbsp; &nbsp; * Its is in in 1NF.</font></div><div><font>&nbsp; &nbsp; * All non-key attribute is fully dependent on the primary key(s), there are no partial dependencies.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font>&nbsp; This relation is also in third normal form (3NF) because:</font></div><div><font>&nbsp; &nbsp; * It is in 2NF.</font></div><div><font>&nbsp; &nbsp; * There are no non-key attributes that depend on other non-key attributes that together depend on the key(s). (there are no transitive dependencies, all attributes depend on the key(s) and only the key(s))</font></div></div><br></div><div><font>&nbsp;</font></div></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="920" div.span: ERD Diagrams and Business Relationship Rules

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1608px; height: 1px; padding-top: 622px; margin-left: 2px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 23px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.span:
* A user may create many titles. A title is created by exactly one user.
* A user may create many reviews. A review is written by exactly one user.
* A user must have one or many permissions. A permission is granted to one or more users (associative relation).
* A user must be part of one or many groups. A group must contain one or many users (associative relation).
* A user may add many titles to their user_title_watchlist. A title may appear on many user_title_watchlists (associative relation).
* A user may report many titles via title_report. A title may be reported by many users (associative relation).
* A title must have one or many authors. An author must be associated with one or many titles (associative relation).
* A title must be part of one or many genres. A genre must be associated with one or many titles (associative relation).
* A title may have many `review`s. A review is part of exactly one title.
This is in first normal form (1NF) because:
* Each entity has a unique identifier, thus all rows for each entity is unique.
* Each cell in each row within each entity only holds a singe value.
* Each cell in each row within each entity has a value that cannot be decomposed further.
This relation is also in second normal form (2NF) because:
* All non-key attribute is fully dependent on the primary key(s), there are no partial dependencies.
This relation is also in third normal form (3NF) because:

* There are no non-key attributes that depend on other non-key attributes that together depend on the key(s). (there are no transitive dependencies, all attributes depend on the key(s) and only the key(s))
